story: Think of a chess player who never commits to a move blindly — they consider the board, try an action, watch what changes, and only then decide what is next. In plain words: Colloquis, previously known as ActiveBuddy and Conversagent, was a company that created conversation-based interactive agents originally distributed via instant messaging platforms. Here is how it actually plays out: The company had offices in New York, New York, and Sunnyvale, California. The model stops being a one-shot answer machine and becomes a coworker that checks its own work. That loop of reason, act, and observe is Colloquis.
